reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: The GitHub app accidentally put my account on billing hold, and it took them over 35 days to take it off. They ignored all my tickets that I sent to get them to remove the hold, and nobody responded to any of them until after 35 days. The customer service was absolutely abysmal.

reviews.text: A friend pushed me into using GitHub, and it all sounds good on paper until you attempt to contact support. I waited over two months for sponsor approval, contacted support waited two weeks with zero response just automated email. So today I decided it’s much easier to just delete your account, keep your code closed and use buy me a coffee, or stripe by itself. I was clearly not important to GitHub as a user. Chances are you’re not either.

reviews.title: Functional, but marred by an ill-conceived "Favorites" feature that tops out at 25 entries
reviews.text:
A prominent "+" button features at the top of the screen - but soon you discover it's capped at a paltry 25 (!) entries. 

This is a plea to the developers to revamp this feature to make it more useful. Mobile users need a way to capture / organize / access the bounty of completely fascinating repos we may encounter on Github. 

Hint: that number is > 25.

reviews.title: Reliability and simple usability lacking
reviews.text: Please just get the basic things right. GitHub needs to be extremely reliable and bulletproof. The basic things need to be intuitive and easy. No bugs. I would rather not have fancy features like copilot AT ALL and have the core product of GitHub actually work. I and many devs will move away from GitHub and not look back if the core product isn’t stable and reliable.

reviews.title: Latest release removed the option to hide the copilot tab
reviews.text:
I don’t understand why AI has to be placed front and center in a way that makes navigation weird. 

The previous version used the tab with the search role to show the copilot view instead of its intended purpose. Weird decision, but at least you had the option to hide that tab. 

The new version makes copilot a “normal” tab but takes away the option to hide it 🫩. It also moves the profile to a button on the top left. Why?? I tap on that more than I do on the AI button. I HAVE Copilot Pro btw and I still don’t use the GitHub app for it. 

I don’t understand why someone would spend time making the app WORSE. That search button on the home tab is STILL broken BTW because instead of using the tab with the search role for it you used it for the ai button. Does nobody see that animation when you dismiss it? Does it actually not bother you that it’s janky or was it that much more important to REMOVE that hide ai toggle from settings. Do we really need the “new session” button on the home tab too? Is it not enough to have it show in the copilot tab?

Ca you PLEASE at least add back the option to hide the ai tab and MAYBE fix that search button??

reviews.title: This is turning into the Copilot app, not GitHub
reviews.text: Every recent release has made Copilot and other AI features front and center, with no way to turn them off. I use this app to check notifications on the go. I never have and never will interact with Copilot, let alone do so from my phone. Please listen to your users let us customize the display, or at the very least bring back the profiles tab. If you're going to replace anything with Copilot why not get rid of the "explore" tab instead? It's like you're _trying_ to drive us away from your platform.
